privileged.title: Privileged users
privileged.subtitle: Perimeter managers, training managers and administrators.
privileged.explainerTitle: Assignment and rights perimeter are two different things
privileged.explainerAssignment: Assigning a training creates an obligation: the manager must validate it too and sees it in their own user space.
privileged.explainerPerimeter: The rights perimeter defines what the manager may see and manage for other people: sites, trainings, or both.
